integrity: All enumerator identities are derived symbolically. The bundled verifier independently enumerates inverse transitions through five states and canonicalizes state-orbits through four states. These finite experiments are corroboration and not infinite proof. Publication priority is best-knowledge, not certified.
scientific_limitations: Fixed ordered binary input/output alphabet; complete unpointed Mealy transducers; state-only isomorphism; no behavioral minimization, algebraic group classification, or larger alphabet claim. Main motivating primary paper full text could not be inspected and an embedded equivalent formula remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Exact labeled and state-isomorphism enumerators of binary bireversible Mealy transducers
